tw-mi-smyrna-marshall-bank-loot-1932.st: Two days after the robbery the Lansing State Journal reported $1,300 recovered and 'a cache of $3,600, the remaining loot' still being sought, with guards on the Belding-Smyrna roads.
src: Lansing State Journal 26 May 1932 p8 (newspapers.com 207257864, PC (a))
